name: Circuit Zaps
author: Lyle Mills
description: Falling-pitch electronic strikes cross two oscillators into ring-modulated zaps, sparks, and driven discharges.

controls.label: Topology
controls.description: Crosses a swept sine with a harder twin, then multiplies them into ring modulation.

controls.label: Dive
controls.description: Deepens and lengthens the fall from a fifth above the note to a four-octave plunge.

controls.label: Tail
controls.description: Extends the discharge from a clipped blip to a ringing electronic trail.

controls.label: Charge
controls.description: Adds a noisy electrical spark and pushes the output circuit into soft saturation.

outputs.main: Mono: the saturated electronic percussion voice. Stereo: the left crossed circuit and independent spark.
outputs.aux: Mono: the clean oscillators and attack transient. Stereo: the right crossed circuit and independent spark.

trigger: Starts a new falling-pitch discharge and electrical spark.
